sentences.en: There are many common problematic research practices such as p-hacking.
sentences.zh: 有许多常见的有问题的研究做法，比如p-值操控。

sentences.en: Life is unpredictable, problematic, oscillating between ups and downs.
sentences.zh: 生活是不可预测的，充满问题，时而上扬，时而低落。

sentences.en: The separation of gold from sand is problematic.
sentences.zh: 从沙子中分离出黄金是有难度的。

senses.zh: 成问题的；有疑问的；阴暗的ad
